summary: The 'MaintAccountCode' system appears to be a web application feature used to maintain account codes within an organization. It involves functionalities for adding, editing, deleting, and listing account codes with associated descriptions and sort orders.
purpose: To manage and maintain account codes efficiently with a user interface that allows system administrators and local administrators to perform CRUD operations, and to ensure that only authorized personnel have the necessary access.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: The unique code for the account.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A brief description of the account.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order in which the account codes are displayed.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: The unique identifier for each record.

actors.permissions: Can view and edit all account codes.
Can manage account codes for the agency they belong to.

workflows.name: Manage Account Codes
steps: User selects an agency from the dropdown.
User selects an account code type from the dropdown.
The system retrieves and displays account code data in a grid.
User can add, edit, or delete an account code using buttons on the grid.
Changes are reflected in the system and the grid is refreshed.

business_rules: Only System Administrators can view and edit account codes for all agencies.
Local Administrators can only manage account codes related to their agency.

validations.validation: Must be specified and contain no more than 50 characters.
Must be specified and contain no more than 200 characters.
Must be specified and be a valid integer.

conditions: Screen is editable only if accessed by authorized users like System Administrators or the appropriate Local Administrator.
system_behavior: The interface displays account codes in a grid with options to add, edit, or delete entries.
Grid supports operations like sorting and filtering based on user role/access.
exceptions: User attempts to modify data without appropriate permissions.
Data retrieval failures due to incorrect agency selection.
